blocks.text:
Plymouth, where Pilgrims settled, accused of breaking 28-year old agreement over National Day of Mourning protest

Nearly 30 years after a violent clash between Native Americans and police, the Massachusetts town of Plymouth is in court accused of “silencing” their National Day of Mourning – again.

A Native American group won a “mixed” victory over the historic Massachusetts town of Plymouth after they sued them for breaking a 30-year-old ‘treaty’ involving their National Day of Mourning.
